The '''Jidlor system''' was located in the [[Jidlor Marches/Legends|Jidlor Marches]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Swaze]]<ref name="GG12" /> [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|162|Jidlor system}}</ref> Each [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]], the rulers of the Swaze were sent to [[Rellnas Minor]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the<ref name="GG12" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Rell system]]. There, the Swaze rulers sought advice from the ''[[un'Yala]]'', [[Chief/Legends|chiefs]] of the [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] [[Rellarin]] species who were widely known for their wisdom.<ref name="GG12" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jidlor system was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The section of the book mentioning the system was authored by [[Craig Robert Carey]].<ref name="GG12" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Jidlor system in grid square J-16.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
